label_full: Example match from the backtest (selected for illustration) · simulated 1 s licensed-feed baseline · real Polymarket price path · paper · 548 of 931 traded backtest matches (58.9%) were profitable at this setting (IS 60.9%, burned OOS 52.2%; seed 14)
what: One match of the tier-0 backtest at the simulated 1 s licensed-feed baseline (video + our CV, V = 1.0 s), shown call by call. Real: the Polymarket price path, jump times and directions, match result, fee, venue delay. Modelled (paper, no order was sent): calls, orders, fills, P&L.

selection.rule: reading = calibrated (tournament_lagcal), V = 1.0 s, seed = the median seed by total P&L (rank 10 of 20, lower median); among matches with >= 6 trades and positive P&L, the one with the most trades; ties by earliest start
selection.seed_rank: 10 of 20 by total P&L (IS + burned OOS)
selection.illustrative_not_typical: This match was chosen for the most trades among profitable ones; it is not a typical match. See profitable_share.

setting.reading_label: R drawn per tournament, calibrated stamp lag 3.14 s (inference)
setting.stamp_lag_note: calibrated 3.14 s is an inference (fast-tier prints), chosen post hoc; the pre-registered stamp lag is 2.0 s
setting.model: src/tier0.py CORRECTED via scripts/tier0_latency_sweep.py cell(); imported unchanged

profitable_share_note: Traded matches = matches with >= 1 fill at the chosen seed; profitable = match P&L > 0 (fees included). Pooled = IS + burned OOS.

price_path.note: every Polymarket print of this match's in-play tape used by the backtest (real); p = outcome-0 price, usd = print size

fields.times_s_after_ball_landing: model clock, origin = the modelled ball landing (point end). cv_call = -CV lead + 20 ms inference + V; order_at_venue = + network to London + 2 ms gateway; order_live = + the venue's order delay; official_stamp = stamp lag; book_reprice = R (drawn per tournament from the live day) + stamp lag
fields.tau_s: book_reprice - order_live; a correct call fills only if tau >= 0 (limit order)
fields.display_clock_ts: ASSUMPTION, display only: the model does not place the ball landing on the historical clock; here the modelled book reprice is put at the historical jump onset (first print of the detector's 10 s window), and the other events keep their modelled offsets
fields.jump_dir_outcome0: +1 = the historical move was up in outcome 0
fields.fill_price_token: price paid for the bought token (live-book model); fill_price_outcome0_equiv puts it on the outcome-0 price axis (1 - price for an outcome-1 buy)
fields.pnl_usd: settlement P&L: shares x (payout - fill price - fee per share); 0 for a miss
fields.edge_usd_net_fee: modelled edge at the fill: shares x (edge per share vs the post-jump price - fee per share); negative for a wrong call

oos_peek: this run reads burned OOS (non-blind) through the sweep's code; results/oos_peeks.log is not written by this script
